summary: Real-provider regression testing completed: auth, protected access, CSV limit validation, invalid recipient validation, webhook acceptance, frontend load, and mobile login passed; Resend single/test submissions failed with HTTP 502.

critical.issue: With EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend, a valid recipient submission returns HTTP 502 and no provider message id.
Real provider test submissions also return HTTP 502, so TEST_SENT cannot be reached and bulk campaigns remain blocked.
email.complained is persisted as BOUNCED rather than a distinct COMPLAINED state required by the specification.

minor.issue: Login uses bearer tokens in localStorage; no httpOnly cookie is set, and CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*'. This does not meet the requested auth hardening/playbook expectations.

integration_issues.issue: Provider failure is surfaced as a gateway HTML 502 rather than the intended JSON error, leaving the UI without its configured error message in live probing.
Frontend immediately changes campaign state to COMPLETED after queue acceptance; it does not poll/display the server-side job or actual progress.

action_items: Diagnose Resend SDK/account/sender acceptance failure and return a stable JSON 502 detail without gateway HTML; verify onboarding@resend.dev/account restrictions.
Add a distinct COMPLAINED recipient status and counter/webhook mapping.
Expose server-side job status/progress to the frontend instead of claiming completion on queue response.
Use explicit CORS origins and the required secure auth/session strategy if auth hardening is in scope.
critical_code_review_comments: Resend provider exceptions are swallowed into a generic 502, making the application unable to distinguish provider/account failure from malformed configuration; log only sanitized exception metadata.
The existing regression suite still asserts MOCKED/SENT response values and is incompatible with EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend; it must be split into explicit mock and real-provider suites.

success_rate.backend: 50% (2/4 existing tests; 2 failures are stale mock assertions plus real-provider failure)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary uniquely named signup users and no production/seed records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL tested. Auth and validation smoke passed. Valid real Resend single/test calls both returned 502; no API key was printed or found in frontend source grep. Re-run provider acceptance, campaign TEST_SENT gate, queue progress, and webhook status after fixes.
rca of the issue: The backend selects Resend correctly and calls resend.Emails.send server-side, but any provider exception is converted to HTTPException(502). Live valid submissions returned a gateway 502, preventing acceptance and campaign progression. Exact upstream reason is hidden by the broad exception handler and should be captured in sanitized backend logs/provider diagnostics.
